provenance.instrument: Mt. Lebanon Code, Chapter 20 Zoning (effective September 26, 2005, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 (code MO6716) dated 2026-02-10. Mt. Lebanon is a home rule municipality. The Census name is Mount Lebanon township. New Laws lists one Chapter 20 amendment: Ord. No. 3383 (2026-07-28), smoke shops as a conditional use in C-2. It was opened and does not touch residential uses. Its PDF header shows 'Enacted: July 28, 2028', a typo: the same PDF says introduced June 23, 2026 and passed in July 2026.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 code date 2026-02-10. New Laws: Ord. 3383 (smoke shops, C-2) not yet codified.
checks: The zoning code has no accessory dwelling unit, accessory apartment or in-law provision
R-1 and R-2 allow single-family detached dwellings and listed accessory uses. A second dwelling unit is not listed (20-202.2, 20-203.2)
In R-1 and R-2 'only one Principal Building may be built on each Lot, except when such Lot is within an Overlay (Transitional) area of said district' (20-104.5)
One storage structure per residential lot (20-803.3.6)
The catch-all special exception for unlisted uses applies only on land in the C-2 district (20-109)
R-3 and R-4 allow two-family dwellings by right on a 6,000 sq ft lot, 50 ft wide (20-204, 20-205)
A conversion that adds dwelling units must meet minimum unit sizes: 500 sq ft (0 BR), 650 (1 BR), 750 (2 BR), 850 (3 BR). 'No Basement shall contain a complete Dwelling Unit' (20-807)
Accessory structures in R-1 to R-3: 14 ft high, 5 ft from side and rear lines. Not in the front yard (district tables, 20-803.1)
An eCode360 search of the Mt. Lebanon Code for rental registration found no rental license or registration chapter. Chapter 8 (licenses) has none
